Theorem
[Meeks--Yau least-area disk] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0260 1. ch33:33.25\group Minimal disks

Let $(N^3,g)$ be compact with convex compressible boundary. Among smooth disk maps whose boundary represents a nontrivial element of $\pi _1(\partial N)$, there is a least-area conformal harmonic map $f_0$. It is embedded, normal to the boundary, and its boundary class is primitive. If that boundary lies in a torus $T$, it generates the infinite cyclic group $\ker (\pi _1(T)\to \pi _1(N))$.
